about: Three brand-only Relpax supplies to a 68-year-old establish the triptan finding, while the directions leave the prescribed mg per dose unknown.
The history shows naratriptan supplies to a 71-year-old who plans to take a tablet that afternoon and has a creatinine clearance of 12 mL/min on the same day, so review is needed before that dose.
Maxalt (rizatriptan) is supplied three times to a person aged 53, below the age of 65, so it must not flag.
